{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) for age
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"Number of valid age entries: {len(valid_ages)}")
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f} years")"}
